annotations.title: Find the MCP(s) for a task

description: Describe in plain language what you want your AI to do. ABCommunity detects the capabilities the task needs (e.g. read email, create task), searches MCP servers, and returns recommendations chosen so each need is covered, plus alternatives, with reasons, links and install availability. Example: 'I want my AI to read Gmail and create Linear tasks.' Next steps: get_installation for setup, compare_mcps to choose between options.

deployment_preference.description: Prefer hosted (remote) or on-machine (local) servers; soft preference

language.description: Language of descriptions in the text summary: 'en' (default) or 'az' (Azerbaijani). The JSON always carries both.

open_source_preference.description: Prefer open-source servers (soft preference, not a hard filter)

platform.description: Target client, e.g. claude-code, cursor, vscode

security_preference.description: Security preference, e.g. 'read-only', 'no local execution', 'official only'

task.description: Natural-language goal. Name the services and actions, e.g. 'query Postgres and post a summary to Slack'

name: find_mcp_for_task
title: Find the MCP(s) for a task
